# Supported sites

<!-- GENERATED by `npm run docs:sites` from src/extraction/adapters. Do not edit by hand. -->

Jobtrail ships **50 site adapters**. Any other site still works through
the generic layers (JSON-LD → microdata → meta/heuristics); adapters add precision,
canonical URLs for duplicate detection, and support for pages without structured data.

**Verified** means the adapter was checked against the live site and a real fixture
is committed. "—" means best-effort: written from knowledge of the site’s markup and
covered by synthetic tests only. See [adding a site adapter](../guides/adding-a-site-adapter.md).

## Site notes

- **Adzuna** — Aggregator; `/land/ad/{id}` redirect URLs resolve to `/details/{id}`.
- **APSjobs** — Australian Public Service jobs. Built on Salesforce Experience Cloud (a slow SPA) — capture after the page has fully rendered. "Company" is the hiring agency.
- **Ashby** — React SPA with hashed class names; JSON-LD is the reliable source. `/application` suffix is stripped for dedupe.
- **BambooHR** — acme.bamboohr.com/careers/{id}. Heavily client-rendered; JSON-LD preferred.
- **Built In** — Legacy city sites (builtinnyc.com etc.) redirect to builtin.com.
- **Dice** — Tech-focused US board.
- **EthicalJobs** — Non-profit and for-purpose sector.
- **Glassdoor** — Class names are CSS-module hashes, so selectors match on stable prefixes (`[class*="JobDetails_"]`). Employer names include the star rating, which the pipeline strips. Dedupe relies on the `jl` id.
- **GradConnection** — Graduate and internship roles. Company is also derivable from the URL path.
- **Greenhouse** — Hosted boards live on boards.greenhouse.io and job-boards.greenhouse.io and include JSON-LD. Company career pages often embed Greenhouse in a cross-origin iframe, which the `activeTab` permission cannot read — open the posting on greenhouse.io to capture it.
- **iCIMS** — The posting renders inside a same-origin iframe (`?in_iframe=1`). The extractor runs in every frame and keeps the best result, so this works without extra permissions.
- **Indeed** — Indeed does not publish JSON-LD on most views, so selectors carry the load. Country sites live on subdomains (au.indeed.com). The search pane uses `vjk`, the posting page uses `jk`.
- **JazzHR** — Formerly “The Resumator”; legacy `#resumator-*` ids are kept as fallbacks.
- **JobAdder** — Recruitment-agency ATS popular in AU/NZ. Boards are usually embedded in agency sites; open the job on jobadder.com to capture it.
- **JobStreet / Jobsdb** — Runs on the SEEK platform since the 2024 unification, so it reuses SEEK’s selectors. Country is a subdomain (my.jobstreet.com, hk.jobsdb.com).
- **Jora** — Aggregator owned by SEEK; many postings link out to the original ad. Country subdomains (au., nz., sg.).
- **Lever** — jobs.lever.co/{company}/{uuid}; the EU instance is jobs.eu.lever.co.
- **LinkedIn** — Two layouts: the public guest page (has JSON-LD) and the signed-in SPA (no JSON-LD; selectors + title pattern). In search view the selected job is read from `currentJobId`. LinkedIn changes class names often — check this adapter first when captures degrade.
- **Naukri** — Salaries are often in lakhs per annum (“12-18 Lacs P.A.”), which the salary parser understands.
- **Oracle Recruiting Cloud** — Candidate Experience pages under /hcmUI/CandidateExperience/…/job/{id}. Knockout.js SPA — capture after load.
- **Oracle Taleo** — Legacy platform with generated element ids; selectors match id suffixes. Being replaced by Oracle Recruiting Cloud (see `oracle-recruiting`).
- **PageUp** — Widely used by Australian universities and government agencies.
- **Personio** — acme.jobs.personio.de/job/{id}.
- **Prosple** — Graduate programs and internships. Next.js app; JSON-LD is the primary source.
- **Recruitee** — acme.recruitee.com/o/{slug}. JSON-LD present on hosted career sites.
- **SAP SuccessFactors** — RMK career sites expose `data-careersite-propertyid` hooks plus microdata; company usually comes from JSON-LD/og:site_name.
- **SEEK** — `data-automation` attributes are SEEK’s test hooks and have been stable for years. The same platform powers JobStreet and Jobsdb (see `jobstreet`).
- **SimplyHired** — Owned by Indeed; the search pane selects jobs with `?job=` which is kept by generic canonicalisation.
- **SmartRecruiters** — Pages carry schema.org microdata, so the microdata strategy usually fills everything.
- **Teamtailor** — Frequently served on customer domains (careers.acme.com); detected via Teamtailor CDN assets.
- **Totaljobs** — Runs on the StepStone platform; `data-at` hooks are shared with StepStone.
- **USAJOBS** — “Company” is the federal department/agency.
- **Welcome to the Jungle (Otta)** — Otta merged into Welcome to the Jungle; app.welcometothejungle.com requires login.
- **Wellfound** — Startup jobs (formerly AngelList Talent). Next.js; JSON-LD is the primary source. Some postings require login.
- **Workable** — apply.workable.com/{company}/j/{shortcode}; `data-ui` hooks are stable.
- **Workday** — `data-automation-id` hooks are stable across tenants. Company comes from the tenant subdomain (acme.wd3.myworkdayjobs.com) or JSON-LD. Capture after the SPA finishes loading.
- **Y Combinator (Work at a Startup)** — Covers both workatastartup.com and ycombinator.com/companies/*/jobs pages.
